name: Azores
about: Weather can flip from sun to rain within the same day. Whale-watching peaks Apr–Jun as blue and sperm whales migrate through.
overview: Nine volcanic islands in the mid-Atlantic — crater lakes, hot springs, and top whale-watching — greener than Madeira.
costOverview: One of the better values in Europe — coffee and a taxi both cost a fraction of mainland Portugal, and even the marquee whale-watching tours stay reasonable.

specialSeasons.text: Peak whale-watching season, with blue whales — the largest animals on Earth — passing through on migration.
